You Don't Know Jack:  
Dropping out! Life anew at forty-two.

By Jack R. Taylo r

Have you ever wondered what you would do if you were able to change your life based on what you know now as a mature, educated, and experienced person? Well, that’s exactly what Jack did.

​

Financially independent at forty-two, with two grown children and two ex-wives behind him, he leaves it all. Challenging life’s axioms and pursuing the life of an iconoclast, he lives out fantasies others can only dream about.

​

In You Don't Know Jack , Taylor shares his extraordinary journey from an underprivileged child to a successful real estate developer in Silicon Valley. This story is about the transformative power of mentorship and the idea that success is less about being in the right place at the right time and more about being with the right people.
